_howto: Feeds in the NIST SP 1500-100 Election Results Common Data Format (XML, V1 or V2), polled by server/src/adapters/nistcdf.js. One entry per feed: feedUrl = the XML download, url = the human results page. generatedDate12HourClock: the exporter writes GeneratedDate on a 12-hour clock with no AM/PM (pick the latest of t / t+12h that isn't in the future). Set enabled:false to stop polling one without deleting it. Every contest in the feed is stored (races/measures no longer filter). allContests (default false; Ohio has no county or municipal contests): set true for a feed that carries the whole ballot. contestRules: optional name rules for this source.

feeds.name: Ohio 2026 General (Ohio Secretary of State)
feeds.note: V1 (IEEE 1622.2) schema, summary format: state + 88 counties, VoteCounts Type=Total only (no per-method split). County turnout: VotersRegistered, SummaryCounts Total BallotsCast, Absentee BallotsOutstanding, precincts SubUnitsReported/TotalSubUnits.
